add.event: 同年戴克里先还颁布货币法令，试图改革税制、稳定币制
add.evidence: in 301 around the same time as the Edict on Prices, Diocletian issued Currency Decrees, which attempted to reform the system of taxation and to stabilize the coinage

add.event: 敕令大致可认为已在罗马为人所知
add.evidence: The edict can tentatively be said to have been known in Rome in 302

add.event: 至戴克里先统治结束时，敕令基本被无视，可能已被正式废止
add.evidence: By the end of Diocletian's reign in 305, it was mostly ignored and may have been formally abrogated.

add.event: 英国驻士麦那领事 William Sherard 首次发现并抄录斯特拉托尼基亚的敕令铭文
add.evidence: was the first to be discovered and copied, by William Sherard, the English consul at Smyrna, in 1709.

add.event: William Martin Leake 首次尝试整理敕令的合成文本
add.evidence: The first attempt at a composite text was made in 1826 by William Martin Leake
